title: APPR � Eligible � 4 Pax Mixed Exception (2 Accessibility + 2 Regular) � Delay Code 65 (Crew) � Meal Below Threshold Only
description:
Verify APPR SOC eligibility, scaled multi-pax entitlements ($120 meal cap), below-threshold OCR auto-approval ($88 meal / $453 total), and automated payout for a 4-PAX booking with mixed exception types (2 Accessibility + 2 Regular) following a 7-hour controllable crew delay (Code 65).

Actual Itinerary: AC 301 YYZ ? YVR, Dep: 15-Jun 15:00
Departure Delay: 420 min (7 hours)
Departure Delay Code: 65 (Flight Crew Shortage / Scheduling) � Controllable
Controllability: Controllable (Code 65)
